topography.project_purpose: CDP. Structurally: 49 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 4 ERC20 tokens, 1 Chainlink feed; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 4 functional families. Its contracts share 8 common project-authored base contract(s) (yamatoaction, yamatobase, uupsbase). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
